description: This Java class 'ExtractStyleDialog' is a GUI dialog component used in Android development within IntelliJ IDEA/JetBrains IDEs. It facilitates extracting styles from XML attributes, allowing users to specify style names, select attributes, and choose modules for refactoring Android resource files.

classes.name: ExtractStyleDialog
classes.description: A dialog class for extracting Android styles from XML attributes, allowing users to input style names, select attributes, and choose modules for resource refactoring.

methods.name: ExtractStyleDialog
methods.description: Constructor initializing the dialog with module, filename, parent style, directory names, and attributes; sets up UI components and module selection.

methods.name: setChecked
methods.description: Checks or unchecks all attribute nodes in the attribute tree.

methods.name: createCenterPanel
methods.description: Returns the main panel of the dialog.

methods.name: doOKAction
methods.description: Handles actions upon OK button press, saving user preferences.

methods.name: getPreferredFocusedComponent
methods.description: Returns the component to focus when dialog opens.

methods.name: doValidate
methods.description: Validates user input for style name, module selection, and resource existence.

methods.name: getStyledAttributes
methods.description: Returns the list of selected XML attributes for styling.

methods.name: getChosenModule
methods.description: Returns the selected module for resource placement.

methods.name: isToSearchStyleApplications
methods.description: Indicates whether to search for style applications after extraction.
